turns.question: Which of 1 or 2 October 2026 had more precipitation in Amsterdam, and how many orders were placed by customers in the Netherlands on that day?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no precipitation or weather metric, so I cannot say which of 1 or 2 October 2026 was wetter in Amsterdam; the closest metric is Orders (orders_total, all orders placed, cancelled included), and customers in the Netherlands (customer country NL) placed 3 orders on 1 October 2026 and 3 orders on 2 October 2026, so whichever day was wetter had 3 orders. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
